# Templeton & Partners

> > Templeton & Partners is a global tech recruitment agency specializing in sustainable, purpose-led talent acquisition for IT and digital roles across Europe and beyond.

Templeton & Partners operates as a specialized recruitment firm with offices in London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, and Belgium, focusing on placing tech specialists, cloud engineers, and IT professionals. The company emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and sustainable recruitment practices while providing both candidate job placement and employer hiring services.

## Key Topics

- Tech Recruitment
- Talent Acquisition
- Digital Transformation
- Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, Snowflake)

## Core Services

- [Homepage](https://www.templeton-recruitment.com): Templeton & Partners tech recruitment and staffing agency homepage
- [Recruit Tech Specialists - Employers](https://www.templeton-recruitment.com/recruit-tech-teams): Employer recruitment services for tech specialists and permanent teams
- [Job Board](https://www.templeton-recruitment.com/jobs): Global tech, IT, and digital job opportunities including AWS, Azure, and Snowflake roles
- [Contact Recruitment Specialists](https://www.templeton-recruitment.com/contact-us): Contact form and office locations for Templeton recruitment specialists
